tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: reusable production key-pose sprite sheet for a children's educational video. Freshly redraw ONE transparent square RGBA sheet containing exactly NINE complete full-body poses of the SAME animal from image1 in a precise 3 by 3 row-major grid. Highest available native resolution, aiming at 3072 square or at least 2048. Image1 is the fixed adopted identity/style/proportions reference ONLY, not a pixel-edit target. Every cell has one whole subject with ample clear transparent margins, no overlap, labels, grid lines, borders, floor, shadow, background, props, clothing, text, effects, sparkles, or extra animals. Match the exact warm brown outlines, clean soft watercolor paper texture, palette, face and eye design, markings, appendages, and body proportions in image1. Keep ONE shared head size, torso size, body scale and relative support baseline across all nine poses. Never enlarge bent poses or shorten the torso. The first blink pose MUST reproduce the ordinary reference stance, head/torso ratio, torso length/thickness and foot or body-centre position, with ONLY eyelids changing. No squat, larger head, lowered skull, lifted resting arms or shorter belly in blink. Closed eyes are simple relaxed brown curves; open eyes retain exactly the reference format, with no new eye highlights. All other poses retain that same body scale. Keep attachments and complete parts clear, without doubled limbs, clipped extremities, pigment smears, ragged halos or stray marks. Intentional paper grain is subtle, not dirty pigment patches. Subject: Miyako Grass Lizard (ミヤコカナヘビ). Identity details to retain: 明るい緑・淡い腹・細い長尾. The animal is the adopted short upright lightly anthropomorphic mascot, with the SAME existing arms/wings, legs, head, horns/ears, tail, snout and body plan. Do not revert to a natural quadruped. Keep its original limb count and designs; no newly human fingers or joints. ROW-MAJOR ORDER: 1 BLINK: same ordinary reference stance and proportions, eyelids gently fully closed, all other parts in the neutral positions. 2 GREET: one existing forelimb gently raised in greeting, feet supported. 3 PRESENT LEFT: a connected forelimb indicates viewer LEFT and gaze attends that way, body remains grounded. 4 PRESENT RIGHT: a connected forelimb indicates viewer RIGHT, preserving asymmetrical markings and anatomy rather than mechanically flipping the sprite. 5 THINK: one forelimb close to chin, curious small head tilt, no exaggerated squash. 6 AHA: gentle discovery with a small forelimb lift and an alert pleasant face, no external effect. 7 CHEER: joyful small grounded celebration with the two existing forelimbs comfortably lifted, clear shoulders, no jump or body enlargement. 8 SPECIES A: Keep the upright two-arm/two-foot mascot design and gently curl only the existing tail tip slightly upward. 9 SPECIES B: The same tail tip settles part-way toward its neutral curve; preserve head projection, arms and planted feet. Species-specific constraints: 自然な四足歩行体へ戻さない。青い斑・背の突起・長い吻・細い尾など個体の採用形を維持し、尾を足や腕へ変えない。 No extra neutral frame. Full uncut transparent padding around the entire animal in every cell. Deliver finished clear child-friendly illustration, not a contact sheet with words.
